newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U alcohol test on market within a year.
newsitem.headline: P&U alcohol test on market within a year.

text.p: Swedish-American drug company Pharmacia & Upjohn said on Thursday it expected an alcohol consumption testing product called 5HTOL to be on the market within one year.
The product is a urine test that measures alcohol consumption up to 24 hours after the latest alcohol intake, also after the alcohol has left the body, the company said in a statement.
The new test complements Pharmacia & Upjohn's current CDTect, which measures continous and high alcohol consumption in blood, the company said.

The new test can be used as a follow-up measure after treating people for alcoholism and within forensic medicine, where it can be used to verify a possible alcohol level at the time of death in accidents, the company said.
